Based on the ordinal logistic regression model controlling for BCG vaccination status (TRTGRP) and patient interaction variables (patients_seen, expect_interact), each additional ongoing medical condition (MHONGO) increases the odds of higher COVID-19 severity by approximately 22.81% (Odds Ratio = 1.23, 95% CI: [0.96, 1.58], corresponding to a 95% CI for the odds increase of [-4.35%, 57.69%], p = 0.107). 

In sensitivity analyses across alternative specifications:
- Using standard adverse event severity grading (AESEV, N=153), each additional ongoing medical condition increases the odds of higher severity by 27.75% (OR = 1.28, 95% CI: [-4.97%, 71.73%], p = 0.105).
- Across the full trial cohort (N=1,000, setting uninfected subjects to baseline level 0), each additional ongoing condition increases the odds of higher COVID-19 severity by 26.84% (OR = 1.27, 95% CI: [11.40%, 44.42%], p < 0.001).
